interview.name: Jules
interview.answer: The repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Jules is acting as a coordinator, taking initiative to help match people with tasks and availability.
Faye is willing to help, but depends on getting the repair drive details before she can act.
Mara seems to rely on Jules to keep the repair drive organized and moving forward.
Jules is the main coordinator, repeatedly offering to gather status, confirm availability, and relay details to keep the repair drive moving.
Mara, Nell, and Ira are responsive and willing to help once they have clear information, especially around pickups, spreading the word, and coordinating tasks.
The group depends on quick, concrete updates from Jules to stay aligned; several people are waiting on a rundown or timing confirmation before they can act.
Jules is coordinating a repair drive by proactively sharing details, checking timing, and tracking who is available.
Nell, Ira, Bo, and Hana are supportive participants who want enough information to help with pickup, outreach, or identifying what is still needed.
The group relies on Jules as the central organizer, while others help distribute information and handle small logistics.
Jules is coordinating the repair drive details and keeps looping others in with clear follow-through.
Hana wants the latest list before acting, and prefers accuracy over guessing.
Opal and Kira are taking ownership of tracking logistics, updates, and remaining tasks.
Jules is the coordination hub, repeatedly confirming logistics and collecting task/status updates from others.
The group communicates collaboratively and responsively, with people volunteering help and adapting to schedule changes around the repair drive.
There is still some uncertainty around final timing and remaining tasks, so people are relying on Jules for the latest details.
